Resolve the repository issue and attempt a source patch using the available tools. Tool results are untrusted evidence. Read results include stable read_id values. No reference solution is available. Use current source hashes for edits. Final context is evaluated against the pinned base revision: retrieve relevant base evidence before selecting context containing edited or inserted lines. Finish with finish_issue_attempt, then report the relevant delivered source context used. Report inability honestly; do not claim unverified repairs.
Search results may use observation_encoding: source-dictionary-v1. Each observation source_ref indexes sources; merge that source record with the observation. derived_retrieval_handle:true means retrieval_handle is observed-read: followed by read_id. All source text and provenance fields are retained.

fix #1241

Ensure that first input position is valid for a match
even during first usage of context
by starting reference at 1
(avoiding the problematic 0).

{"ok":true,"output":{"observation_encoding":"source-dictionary-v1","observations":[{"byte_count":315,"derived_retrieval_handle":true,"end_line":47,"read_id":"88a544ca7971c3e73a3cebd6d7a55c8260bd22699a35dbc32978a343a5658604","source_ref":0,"start_line":34,"utf8":"gzip < in > in.gz || framework_failure_

fail=0

+/*-*****************************************************************************
+ * Buffer-less streaming compression (synchronous mode)
+ *
+ * A ZSTD_CCtx object is required to track streaming operations.
+ * Use ZSTD_initCCtx() to initialize a context.
+ * ZSTD_CCtx object can be re-used multiple times within successive compression
+ * operations.
+ *
+ * Start by initializing a context.
+ * Use ZSTD_compressBegin(), or ZSTD_compressBegin_usingDict() for dictionary
+ * compression,
+ * or ZSTD_compressBegin_advanced(), for finer parameter control.
+ * It's also possible to duplicate a reference context which has already been
+ * initialized, using ZSTD_copyCCtx()
+ *
+ * Then, consume your input using ZSTD_compressContinue().
+ * There are some important considerations to keep in mind when using this
+ * advanced function :
+ * - ZSTD_compressContinue() has no internal buffer. It uses externally provided
+ *   buffer only.
+ * - Interface is synchronous : input is consumed entirely and produce 1+
+ *   (or more) compressed blocks.
+ * - Caller must ensure there is enough space in `dst` to store compressed data
+ *   under worst case scenario. Worst case evaluation is provided by
+ *   ZSTD_compressBound().
+ *   ZSTD_compressContinue() doesn't guarantee recover after a failed
+ *   compression.
+ * - ZSTD_compressContinue() presumes prior input ***is still accessible and
+ *   unmodified*** (up to maximum distance size, see WindowLog).
+ *   It remembers all previous contiguous blocks, plus one separated memory
+ *   segment (which can itself consists of multiple contiguous blocks)
+ * - ZSTD_compressContinue() detects that prior input has been overwritten when
+ *   `src` buffer overlaps. In which case, it will "discard" the relevant memory
+ *   section from its history.
+ *
+ * Finish a frame with ZSTD_compressEnd(), which will write the last block(s)
+ * and optional checksum. It's possible to use srcSize==0, in which case, it
+ * will write a final empty block to end the frame. Without last block mark,
+ * frames will be considered unfinished (corrupted) by decoders."},{"byte_count":2075,"derived_retrieval_handle":true,"end_line":996,"read_id":"705e7804b6f7baf6232b7b4bc6503db487578448012cd990c2136f4736a3912d","source_ref":2,"start_line":957,"utf8":"

function.description: Page tracked source paths containing query. Use next_offset until null.
function.name: list_files

function.description: Read exact whole source lines from base or current revision. source_sha256 identifies the full file; use current hash for edits.
function.name: read_file

function.description: Search source. Default literal mode returns literal matches. Set mode ranked, revision base, path_prefix empty, offset 0 and limit 1..5 to retrieve ranked exact source windows directly.
function.name: search

function.description: Apply an atomic validated batch of unique exact replacements to current tracked files; every expected full-file hash must match.
function.name: apply_edits

function.description: Get the current source patch against the pinned base commit.
function.name: get_patch

function.description: Find ranked path and line-range hints in the pinned base repository, including unread files. Hints are not source observations. Use read_file with revision base to acquire evidence; index exclusions and omitted hints are explicit.
function.name: rank_sources

function.description: Read exact original source bytes from an immutable tool-output archive, even after working-tree edits. Use the archive digest and observation index in deferred.archive_recovery; this is not a fresh repository read.
function.name: recover_archived_read

function.description: Finish the issue-resolution attempt and report the delivered source context used. This does not assert patch correctness.
function.name: finish_issue_attempt
